last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity in this session for timeout tracking. Updated automatically on each API request to monitor session activity and detect idle sessions.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated. Null indicates an active session; populated when session is manually terminated or automatically expires due to inactivity.

ITodoAppUserSession.ISummary.description:
Secure summary view of user session information optimized for list displays while protecting sensitive connection details.

Provides essential session tracking information including creation time, last activity, and expiration status while excluding sensitive connection metadata for security protection. Suitable for displaying session lists where security considerations require protection of IP addresses, user agent details, and connection URLs.

This summary maintains core session management functionality while implementing security boundaries to prevent exposure of potentially sensitive connection information. Sessions represent authenticated connections from user devices with comprehensive backend tracking while maintaining appropriate security boundaries in API responses.

The design supports efficient session management operations while providing essential tracking information for timeout management and security monitoring, respecting the principle of minimal data exposure for security compliance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the todo item. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format for secure identification and database integrity.

text.description: Todo item description text containing the task content. Must be between 1-500 characters as specified in requirements, supporting meaningful task descriptions while maintaining performance constraints.

completed.description: Completion status indicating whether the todo item is finished. Defaults to false (incomplete) and can be toggled by users to track task progress through the application workflow.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was originally created. Automatically set by the system using server time to track task creation history and user activity patterns.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last modified. Updated automatically on each change to track modification history and support synchronization operations.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted. Null indicates active item; populated when item is deleted while preserving historical records for audit and recovery purposes.

ITodoAppTodo.description:
Core todo item entity representing individual tasks managed by authenticated users in the Todo application.

Stores todo tasks with comprehensive text descriptions, completion status tracking, and detailed audit trail management. Each todo belongs to exactly one user through backend authentication context, ensuring proper access control and user-specific task management.

The entity follows minimal design principles with essential fields for basic todo functionality while supporting soft deletion for data preservation. Completion status tracking allows users to monitor task progress through simple workflow management without complex state transitions.

This DTO provides complete information retrieval while protecting user ownership context through authentication boundaries. The design supports efficient todo management operations while maintaining data integrity and security requirements.

text.description:
Todo item description text containing the task content. Must be between 1-500 characters as specified in the Prisma schema requirements. This field is mandatory for creating valid todo items and supports basic text formatting for task descriptions.

The text content represents the core information of the todo task that users need to complete. It should be descriptive enough to clearly communicate the task while remaining concise for efficient task management. The character limit ensures reasonable task descriptions without overwhelming the user interface.

completed.description:
Completion status indicating whether the todo item is finished. Defaults to false (incomplete) when creating new todos. Users can optionally set this to true if creating a todo that is already completed.

This field allows for flexible todo creation workflows where users might add tasks that are already done for tracking purposes. The default incomplete state encourages users to actively manage their task completion progress.

ITodoAppTodo.ICreate.description:
Creation DTO for new todo items in the Todo application system.

Contains only the user-provided fields required to create a new todo item. The text field is mandatory and must meet the 1-500 character length constraint specified in the Prisma schema. The completed field is optional and defaults to false if not provided, supporting various creation workflows.

System-managed fields like id, created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at are excluded as they are automatically generated by the backend system. User ownership is handled through authentication context rather than explicit user_id field, ensuring proper security and data integrity.

This DTO follows the minimal design principles of the Todo application, focusing on essential user input while maintaining comprehensive backend tracking and security measures.

text.description:
Todo item description text containing the updated task content. Must be between 1-500 characters as specified in the Prisma schema requirements. This field is optional for partial updates, allowing users to modify just the task description.

When provided, the text content replaces the existing todo description while maintaining the same validation constraints as the creation process. Users can update task descriptions to reflect changing requirements or improved clarity without affecting other todo properties.

completed.description:
Updated completion status for the todo item. This optional field allows users to mark tasks as completed or revert completed tasks back to incomplete status.

The field supports flexible task management workflows where completion status may change multiple times during a todo's lifecycle. Users can update this independently of other todo properties for efficient task tracking.

ITodoAppTodo.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for modifying existing todo items in the Todo application system.

All fields are optional to support partial updates, allowing users to modify individual properties without providing the complete todo object. This design enables efficient updates for common scenarios like marking tasks complete or editing descriptions.

The text field maintains the same validation constraints (1-500 characters) as the create DTO to ensure data consistency. System-managed fields and ownership information are excluded as they cannot be modified through user requests, maintaining proper security boundaries.

This DTO supports the Todo application's flexible update patterns while respecting data integrity rules and security requirements. The partial update capability reduces unnecessary data transmission and simplifies client implementations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the todo item. Generated automatically using UUID v4 format upon creation. This identifier is immutable and serves as the primary key for all todo operations.

text.description: Todo item description text containing the actual task content. Must be between 1-500 characters as specified in requirements. Supports full-text search capabilities for efficient filtering and retrieval.

completed.description: Completion status indicating whether the todo item is finished. Defaults to false (incomplete) when created. Users can toggle this status to track task progress and filter todos by completion state.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was originally created. Uses ISO 8601 format for consistent date/time representation across the system. This field is automatically set upon todo creation.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last modified. Automatically updated whenever any todo property changes. Useful for tracking recent activity and sorting by modification date.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted. Null indicates active item, while a timestamp indicates deletion time. Supports data recovery and audit trail maintenance while preserving data integrity.

user.description: Owner user information for the todo item. Provides context about who created and manages this todo. Includes essential user details for display purposes while maintaining security boundaries.

ITodoAppTodo.ISummary.description:
Summary view of todo items optimized for list displays and overview purposes.

Provides essential todo information including ownership context, modification timestamps, and completion status tracking. This lightweight variant is designed for efficient list operations where complete todo details are not required.

Includes soft deletion tracking through the deleted_at field for proper data management and audit trail maintenance. The summary format supports paginated listings, search results, and any scenario requiring quick todo reference without full detail loading.

Maintains proper user context through the user relationship while respecting performance considerations for large-scale todo management operations.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Starts from 1 for the first page. Used in combination with limit parameter to implement efficient pagination for large todo collections.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination control. Maximum 100 items per page to ensure optimal performance and reasonable response sizes for todo list operations.

search.description: Full-text search query for filtering todo items by text content. Supports partial matches and leverages database indexing for efficient search performance. Maximum 100 characters to prevent overly broad searches.

completed.description: Filter by completion status. If provided, returns only todos matching the specified completion state (true for completed, false for incomplete). Useful for focusing on active tasks or reviewing finished work.

oneOf.description: Sort by creation date - shows newest or oldest todos first based on order parameter.
Sort by modification date - shows most recently updated todos first for activity tracking.
Sort alphabetically by todo text content for organized listing.
Sort by completion status - groups completed and incomplete todos together.

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options include creation date, modification date, text content, and completion status. Supports flexible organization of todo lists based on user preferences.

oneOf.description: Ascending order - from oldest/smallest to newest/largest. Useful for chronological viewing.
Descending order - from newest/largest to oldest/smallest. Default for recent activity focus.

order.description: Sort order for results. Ascending (asc) for chronological order, descending (desc) for reverse chronological order. Works in combination with sort_by parameter.

ITodoAppTodo.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering criteria for todo item queries with comprehensive parameter validation.

Provides flexible filtering options for searching todo items including pagination controls, text search with character limits, completion status filtering, and multiple sorting preferences. All parameters are optional, allowing users to construct queries ranging from simple listings to complex multi-criteria searches.

The search functionality leverages database indexes for optimal performance, particularly for text search operations. Parameter validation ensures query safety and prevents resource-intensive operations that could impact system performance.

Supports common todo management scenarios such as finding specific tasks by text, filtering by completion status for focused work sessions, and organizing todos by recent activity or creation date for efficient task management.
